title: .netrc: quoted password with spaces
summary: A synthetic single-line .netrc entry where login and password are double-quoted strings and the password contains spaces.
rationale: Quoting is the only way a space can occur in a netrc password. A reader that ends the value at the first space reports only a fragment and leaves the rest exposed.

expectation.rationale: Flag the whole quoted string content, including the spaces. curl states that since 7.84.0 quoted strings are supported and that quoting is the only way a space can be used in a username or password. A report that includes the surrounding double quotes is not wrong (envelope).

sources.supports: Since 7.84.0, curl also supports quoted strings. They start and end with double quotes and support the escaped special letters. Quoted strings are the only way a space character can be used in a username or password.
